hierarchy.tagline: text-xs md:text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#00ff41]

layout.mobile: Mobile-first, bottom-docked glassmorphism card covering the lower 60% of screen, hero image takes top 40%.
layout.desktop: Split screen or right-aligned floating panel (max-w-md). Image covers full background, left side is empty to show the racing cars.
layout.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-8) for the auth card to prevent collision. High density but optical alignment.

auth_card.classes: bg-[#0a0a0c]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-t-3xl md:rounded-3xl

tabs.classes: flex p-1 bg-black/50 rounded-xl border border-white/5 mb-8

inputs.classes: bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-xl h-14 px-4 text-white focus:border-[#00ff41] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00ff41]/30 transition-all placeholder:text-white/30

submit_button.classes: w-full h-14 bg-[#00ff41] text-black font-heading tracking-wider text-xl uppercase rounded-xl hover:bg-white hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,65,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 transform active:scale-[0.98]

biometric_button.classes: w-full h-14 border-2 border-white/10 bg-transparent text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:border-[#00ff41] hover:text-[#00ff41] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2

legal_links.classes: text-[10px] text-white/40 flex justify-center gap-3 uppercase tracking-widest mt-6

image_urls.description: Drag racing car at night. To be used as full-screen fixed background with a heavy dark gradient overlay at the bottom so the auth form remains legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign /app/frontend/src/pages/AuthPage.js completely using the provided design system.
Do NOT alter the Axios API calls, routing, or state variables like biometricEnabled.
Import fonts 'Bebas Neue' and 'Outfit' via Google Fonts in index.css.
Apply a cinematic lighting effect: Add an absolute div with a radial gradient glow (green) behind the wordmark BETZ.
Ensure 'Bet Secure. Get Paid.' is explicitly styled with text-[#00ff41].
Keep all data-testid attributes exactly as they were in the original file.
For the background image, wrap it in a fixed positioned container with z-0, and place a bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/80 to-transparent absolute overlay on top of it.
On mobile, the form container should be rounded-t-[2.5rem] and stick to the bottom. On desktop (md:), it should be a floating rounded-3xl card on the right side.
Replace Shadcn default inputs with custom styled Tailwind inputs matching the 'Tactile / Technical' specifications above.
Make the submit button extremely prominent, using the primary green and uppercase Bebas Neue font.
